Alice — thanks for the files. I've sketched an initial cutover approach below and attached a runbook draft (privcp-id-cutover-runbook.md) and a couple of SAML/SCIM config snippets (saml-attribute-mapping-snippets.txt). High level: 

1) Pre-cutover (2 days before):
   - Confirm IdP metadata is stable and certificate TTL >= 7 days.
   - Provision a Redwood service account for SCIM with scoped permissions (users:write, groups:read).
   - Agree canonical attribute names (we prefer 'email' and 'displayName'; can accept 'mail' if that's what you emit).
2) Test window (non-prod):
   - Run SCIM dry-run against our staging Private control plane. Validate duplicate handling and conflict resolution.
3) Cutover window (proposed): 2027-04-30 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic)
   - Disable inbound provisioning to the legacy system to avoid dual-writes.
   - Enable SCIM sink to Private CP and monitor job success/fail counts.
4) Post-cutover verification (2 hours):
   - Smoke tests (login, token exchange, role-based access in one tenant).

Edge cases / concerns I want to call out:
- SCIM rate spikes causing 409 conflicts (duplicate create). We'll implement idempotent upsert and a small backoff on 409s.
- Missing email attribute: we'll reject and flag users to manual remediation if no stable identifier exists.
- Group-to-role mapping ambiguity: we will ship a fallback mapping (default "viewer") for unmatched groups and highlight in the audit report.

I'll need one of you to confirm IdP emits 'email' or we should map 'mail'. Also: what's your internal rotation cadence for the SCIM service credential? We can support 30/90/180-day rotations but need to coordinate how we fetch new creds without breaking sync.

Attaching: privcp-id-cutover-runbook.md, saml-attribute-mapping-snippets.txt

Quick technical notes from my review of the sample CSV and IdP metadata: 

- Sample export lists 'mail' and 'userPrincipalName' but not 'email' — we should map 'mail' -> email in the SAML mapping. Add mapping test case for accounts with mail empty but userPrincipalName present.
- SCIM patch ordering: if ACME's sync sends group adds and user attribute patches concurrently, we could see transient role mismatches. Add a reconciliation job that runs after the initial sync to ensure role parity (compare SCIM state vs expected roles).
- For duplicate create attempts we should include an idempotency key derived from externalId (if present) or hashed userPrincipalName + source.
- Audit events: Redwood will emit the following to the Private control plane audit log: identity.provision.create, identity.provision.update, identity.provision.delete, identity.saml.assertion. All of these are available in the control plane logs for 90 days (longer retention available under add-on).

I'll add a short test harness to the runbook that verifies audit events land correctly during the smoke tests. Also flagging a regulatory item: ACME's security team requires proof of key rotation before production cutover (screenshot or DocuSign confirmation acceptable).

-Marissa

Adding the config snippets I tested locally (included in saml-attribute-mapping-snippets.txt) and a SCIM filter suggestion. Notes: 

- SAML assertion mapping (pseudo):
  NameID -> userPrincipalName
  email -> assertion.attributes.mail || assertion.attributes.email
  groups -> assertion.attributes.memberOf (map to group display names)

- SCIM upsert pattern: PUT /scim/v2/Users/{externalId} when externalId is present; fallback to POST with idempotency header X-Idempotency-Key if not.

- Reconciliation job: implement a single-threaded worker that compares group membership hashes and emits a reconciliation report. Run immediately after cutover and again at T+24h.

Proposed cutover checklist items for runbook (I'll add as a section):
- Confirm IdP cert validity (>=7d)
- Create SCIM service account credentials and store in Secrets Manager with rotation enabled
- Run non-prod dry-run and review reconciliation report
- Schedule RW support on-call for the window

I'll be available during the proposed window.

-Dev

Rollback plan (quick):

 - Revoke the SCIM service credential created for cutover and re-instate previous credential.

Smoke test checklist (minimum):
 - Create new user via SCIM -> user appears in Private CP, can SSO in 1st login
 - Update group -> role changes reflect in 60s
 - Delete user -> user access revoked and audit shows identity.provision.delete
 - Reconciliation job report shows 0 mismatches or documented exceptions only

Compliance deliverables before cutover:
 - Proof of SCIM service account rotation policy (screenshot or DocuSign)
 - Signed acknowledgement of cutover window and rollback steps by ACME security
